verdict.rationale: HumanLayer has event-adjacent automation: `humanlayer automation run` can start a coding session from CI jobs, cron or scripts, and its GitHub, Jira and Linear integrations create tasks from issues or tickets. Slack also receives task artifact updates. However, the evidence shows no user-definable rules engine, and triggering relies on external CI/cron tooling. It is also unclear whether issue-to-task creation is automatic or manual. Missing for 10: a native rule/trigger definition system (event → condition → action), documented automatic event-driven task creation, configurable trigger conditions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
